name: Honey
oneLiner: HONEY is Berachain's dollar stablecoin, minted 1:1 from a basket of USDC, USDT0, pyUSD, and USDe with Basket Mode safety controls.
collateral: 1:1 basket of USDC, USDT0, pyUSD, and USDe on Berachain
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint/redeem against centralized stablecoin collateral with Basket Mode safety

applicabilityBasis.summary: Berachain docs describe HONEY as a USD-soft-pegged, fully collateralized native stablecoin minted 1:1 from whitelisted collateral for payments and remittances.

genius.notes: HONEY is a governance-controlled DeFi stablecoin issued on Berachain by a Cayman Islands foundation; minting is permissioned through the HoneyFactory contract with collateral whitelisting controlled by BGT governance. No PPSI application, OCC filing, or GENIUS authorization has been announced. The Berachain Foundation is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands, making a foreign-issuer exception pathway the most likely route if authorization were ever sought, but no such intent has been publicly disclosed. Reserve transparency is on-chain via the HoneyFactory vaults, visible at honey.berachain.com; no formal third-party attestation report exists.

The issuer is a Cayman Islands foundation with no publicly disclosed U.S. regulatory pathway under the GENIUS Act.

mintAuthority.summary: HONEY is minted through the Berachain HoneyFactory by depositing whitelisted stablecoin collateral (USDC, USDT0, pyUSD/BYUSD, USDe) into per-asset vaults; collateral whitelisting and mint/redeem rates are configured by Berachain governance, with Basket Mode safety controls.

controls.label: HoneyFactory mint hub
controls.capDescription: HONEY mints only when whitelisted stablecoin collateral is deposited through the HoneyFactory into per-asset vaults; Basket Mode restricts mint/redeem when a collateral asset depegs.
controls.evidence: Berachain docs describe HoneyFactory as the central hub routing whitelisted collateral deposits to per-asset vaults and minting HONEY 1:1, with Basket Mode safety controls.

controls.label: Berachain governance (collateral whitelist & rate admin)
controls.capDescription: Berachain governance adds collateral assets and configures per-asset mint/redeem rates and fee distribution for the HoneyFactory.
controls.evidence: Berachain docs state new collateral assets are added through governance and mint/redeem rates are configurable per collateral asset by governance.

review.evidence: Berachain HONEY documentation describes a governed basket-collateral mint via the HoneyFactory contract with per-asset vaults, governance-controlled collateral whitelisting and rates, and Basket Mode safety controls.
review.sourceFreeRationale: HoneyFactory mint mechanism and governance whitelist confirmed from Berachain docs; the live HoneyFactory owner/governance admin address was not independently read on-chain.
